name: Lightning Round
description: A buzzer round plus two guess-the-number questions — quick-fire class energy with a leaderboard at the end.

intro.message:
⚡ LIGHTNING ROUND!

First: a buzzer round — questions are asked out loud. Buzz fast, answer faster. Wrong answers are locked out until the next question.

Then: guess-the-number. Closest guess wins the points.

buzzer.prompt: Listen for the question, then BUZZ!

guess1.prompt: How many liters of water does a cow drink in a single day?

guess2.prompt: In what year was the very first text message sent?

end.message: ⚡ That's the Lightning Round! Same time next week.
